research.title: How Order-to-Cash Works in Order Management (Oracle docs)
Oracle Fusion Order to Cash Cycle overview

imageNote: This course is 100% conceptual Order-to-Cash process instruction with no software UI to screenshot (Oracle Fusion Cloud is login-gated enterprise software with no public documentation screenshots available). All slides use the title/steps/code/outro brand-card types only — no screenshot slides, no source images. The example company (LTV Manufacturing Corporation) and its customer (Harborview Industrial Supply), and all order, invoice, and dollar figures used across this course, are original and clearly fictional, not sourced from any real company's records.
